captions.detailed: A pair of compact theatre opera glasses configured as pocket binoculars. The design features two short, thick cylindrical barrels in a matte black finish, accented by gold-colored focus rings near the eyepieces. A central gold-colored hinge pivot connects the two halves, allowing them to fold along a vertical axis. Each eyepiece features a continuously rotating adjustment ring.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of compact theatre opera glasses with two short black cylindrical barrels, gold-colored focus rings, and a central folding hinge. The barrels should fold relative to each other on a central revolute joint, and each focus ring should rotate continuously.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed from three primary components: a central hinge block (the base) and two symmetrical optical barrels (left and right). The central hinge is modeled using a combination of small boxes and cylinders to form the pivot connection. Each barrel is constructed by joining a main cylinder, a chamfered eyepiece ring, and a gold-colored focus ring (modeled as a hollow cylinder or thick ring). Revolute joints connect the left and right barrels to the central hinge, while continuous joints allow the focus rings to rotate on the barrels.
